label: SMALL_SAMPLE_HOSTED_EXECUTION_PLANNING_NOT_PRECISE_FORECAST
interpretation: These are workload scenarios, not validated forecasts. Observed workflows used only two requests each and one small ACCEPT review. Larger sources, repeated reviews, full16k responses and service load can dominate. Plan the fixed five ready requirements within an approximately two-hour budget, without claiming a precise count or adding repeated generations to fill time.
time_guard: Existing rule starts a new requirement only with1920seconds remaining:10*180seconds request timeout+120seconds client reserve. Stops early on acceptance/terminal outcomes. Unstarted entries remain NOT_RUN. Local engine checks have no hard process deadline; this is an execution-budget guard, not an absolute walltime guarantee.

fixed_queue.selection_basis: Same predeclared source/schema/scope-ready shuffled queue; capacity blockers removed only because arbitrary byte guard is removed and verified supplied-text+output counts fit the published model context; no generated-performance filter
